calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id,
    bool_or(s.store_id=999 OR pr.category='ZZ Test') OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_id) AS dummy
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key=f.product_key
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e
),
ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, count(*) n FROM dim_member CROSS JOIN p WHERE p.e BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'versions_valid_per_member' k, n::VARCHAR v, count(*) c FROM ver GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'active_all', cur.tier, count(DISTINCT a.member_id) FROM act a CROSS JOIN p JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id=a.member_id AND p.e BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'active_dummy_flag', a.dummy::VARCHAR, count(*) FROM act a GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
l AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.channel_code, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e
)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l) AS all_active,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l WHERE status IS NULL OR status<>'cancelled') AS excl_cancelled,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE status='cancelled') AS cancelled_lines,
       (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l) AS dup_line_ids,
       (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
       (SELECT min(sale_date) FROM l) AS min_sale
